title: 第3章 尘羽这不是师徒间的握手手吧第4章 病娇大逆徒未来女剑仙的奇怪癖好
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
“尘羽，你......你这是做什么？”
谢曦雪突然被握住了小手，顿时陷入了困惑。
她下意识地想要将握住自己的手给甩掉，但还没起手，内心却莫名地有些不舍。
自从徒弟搬出去以后，他们最多只是见面聊上几句。
上一次做牵手这样亲密的动作，还是在自己徒弟十岁不到的时候呢！
“突然想握握师尊的手了？不可以吗？”
“可以吧......”
谢曦雪的语气有些不确定，但是用弱弱的声音询问道：
“但师徒之间的握手是这个样子的吗？”
江尘羽一本正经地胡说八道：
“当然啦，我看书上都是这么写的！”
“这其实也是一种古代传下来的礼数，只不过年代太过久远，所以失传了而已！”
本来，江尘羽还打算老老实实地当孝徒的。
但是看到绝美的清冷师尊递来的玉手后，他顿时就脑子一热，牵了上去。
‘是师尊先勾引我的，我只不过是稍稍过分一点，应该不算大逆不道吧？’
“行，那就当有这么个礼节吧！”
谢曦雪有理由怀疑自家徒弟在骗人，但是感受着手上传来从前未有的感觉，以及心脏砰砰的跳动，她最终还是决定相信徒弟一回。
估摸着牵了十来息左右，一直牵到清冷师尊白皙的脸颊浮现无法压抑的红晕时，他才恋恋不舍的将师尊的小手松开。
与绝美师尊拉了下勾，做了要陪伴她一辈子的约定，江尘羽轻咳了一声随后说道：
“师尊，您最近还是先别着急修炼，稍稍调养一下身子！”

“既然已经确定您平安无事，那么徒儿就先行告退了！”
“嗯，你走吧！”
闻言，谢曦雪有些不舍，但最终也没好意思让刚刚才被自己强吻过的徒儿继续陪伴自己这位危险的逆师。
......
从师尊的庭院离开，回到了自己家，江尘羽感受到一抹熟悉的气息后停下了脚步，随后望向了斜前方。
“师尊，您身上师祖的味道怎么那么浓郁，你们是做了什么不可告人的事情吗？”
一道冷清的声音落下。
与此同时，江尘羽伸出手来朝着斜前方一抓，很快一道娇喝声便传来。
“师尊，您对我们还是一如既往的粗暴呢！
也不知道是我们哪里惹您不高兴了，你对待我们的态度，甚至比对一只狗还要差上不少！”
被一只能量巨手攥在掌心，独孤傲霜撇了撇嘴，浑不在意的说道。
就仿佛，被无情地捏在掌心中的人不是她，而是什么毫不相干的人一般。
闻言，江尘羽的神情没有丝毫变化，足足将少女在高空上悬挂了好一会儿之后，他才将其随意地往地上一扔。
与对待师尊时的恭敬不同，在对待自己的女徒弟时，反派魔尊的手段则是要粗暴上许多。
将她攥在手心这种惩罚，已经是江尘羽手下留情后做的选择。
要是换作反派魔尊本人，此时的独孤傲霜估摸着已经被一巴掌掀飞在墙上，抠都抠不下来了！
“过来！”
江尘羽对着大徒弟独孤傲霜冷淡的说道，就仿佛是在呼唤一位毫无人生自主权的仆从。
不过，若是真计较起来的话，独孤傲霜在反派魔尊手底下的待遇确实要比仆从要来得差上许多。
“师尊，你和师祖到底在做什么呢？”
content_en:
"Chenyu, you...what are you doing?"
Xie Xixue's little hand was suddenly held, and she fell into confusion.
She subconsciously wanted to shake off the hand that was holding her, but before she started, she felt inexplicably reluctant to let go.
Since the apprentice moved out, the most they could do was meet and chat for a few words.
The last time he did something as intimate as holding hands was when his apprentice was less than ten years old!
"Suddenly I want to hold Master's hand? Isn't that allowed?"
"Okay..."
Xie Xixue's tone was a little uncertain, but she asked in a weak voice:
"But is this what the handshake between master and disciple looks like?"
Jiang Chenyu said nonsense seriously:
"Of course, that's what I read in the books!"
"This is actually a kind of etiquette passed down from ancient times, but it's just that it was lost because it was too old!"
Originally, Jiang Chenyu planned to be a dutiful disciple.
But after seeing the beautiful hand handed over by the beautiful Master Qing Leng, he immediately became excited and took it.
'It was Master who seduced me first. I just went a little too far, so it shouldn't be considered treasonous, right? ’
"Okay, then let's have such etiquette!"
Xie Xixue had reason to suspect that her apprentice was lying, but feeling the unprecedented sensation in her hands and the pounding of her heart, she finally decided to believe her apprentice.
He held it for about ten breaths, until an uncontrollable blush appeared on Master Qing Leng's fair cheeks, and then he reluctantly let go of Master's little hand.
After hooking up with the beautiful master and making an agreement to accompany her for the rest of her life, Jiang Chenyu coughed lightly and then said:
"Master, you'd better not be anxious about practicing recently and take some time to recuperate your body!"
"Now that I have determined that you are safe and sound, I will leave first!"
"Well, let's go!"
Hearing this, Xie Xixue was a little reluctant to give up, but in the end she was too embarrassed to let the disciple she had just forcibly kissed continue to accompany her dangerous rebel master.
...
After leaving the master's courtyard and returning to his home, Jiang Chenyu stopped when he felt a familiar aura, and then looked diagonally ahead.
"Master, why is the smell of Master so strong on your body? Have you done something ulterior?"
A cold voice fell.
At the same time, Jiang Chenyu stretched out his hand and grabbed it diagonally forward, and soon a shout came.
"Master, you are still as rude to us as ever!
I don’t know why we made you unhappy. Your attitude towards us is even worse than that towards a dog! "
Being held in the palm of a giant energy hand, Dugu Aoshuang curled her lips and said nonchalantly.
It was as if the person being ruthlessly pinched in the palm was not her, but some unrelated person.
Hearing this, Jiang Chenyu's expression did not change at all. After hanging the girl high in the sky for a long time, he casually threw her to the ground.
Different from the respectful way he treated his master, when he treated his female apprentice, the villain Demon Lord's methods were much more rough.
The punishment of holding her in the palm of his hand was Jiang Chenyu's choice after showing mercy.
If it had been the villain Demon Lord himself, Dugu Aoshuang would have been slapped against the wall and would have been unable to pick it off!
"Come here!"
Jiang Chenyu said coldly to his eldest disciple Dugu Aoshuang, as if he was calling a servant who had no autonomy in life.
However, if we really care about it, Dugu Aoshuang's treatment under the hands of the villain Demon Lord is indeed much worse than that of a servant.
"Master, what are you and Master doing?"
